post_text: 400 helmets handed to Vizag Home Guards to protect our frontline heroes. Every helmet = one life protected. Join us in making our streets safer.
200+ families received FREE health checkups at our mega medical camp in Vijayawada. Preventive care saves lives. Grateful to NTR District Police for the partnership.
Two flags flying high! Boccia Silver in Bahrain and Weightlifting Bronze in Malaysia for our supported athletes. Proud of Sai Shakthi and team.
Clean water is dignity. We donated drinking water dispensers to MVP Police Station, the Visakhapatnam MRO Office, and several Primary Health Centres this week.
New Road Safety Clubs are live in regional colleges. Student-led seminars + parent counselling to tackle drunk-driving. Prevention starts with awareness.
Congratulations to Dr. Sanakayyala Radha Madhavi on being appointed Guntur District Mahila Morcha President. Onward and upward for women in civic leadership.

Lets salute our heroes. Bharatiyam - a National Integration Cultural Program marking Kargil Vijay Diwas. 25 July 2026 from 9:45 am at VMRDA Childrens Arena, Siripuram Junction, Visakhapatnam. Live band by the Eastern Naval Command Naval Symphony.

Bharatiyam lit up the VMRDA Childrens Arena today. Classical and folk performances from St Josephs College for Women, School of Wonder Kids, Nrutya Bharati, Kalaradhana Music and Dance Academy and more, all in tribute to Kargil Vijay Diwas. On stage, ACME and Aap Sab Ki Awaaz honoured Dr. Chandra Shekhar and the wives of late CPO Ashok Kumar Singh and late L Naik Kolli Purna Ramachandra Reddy. Unsung stories of our heroes, remembered.
Moments from Bharatiyam at the VMRDA Childrens Arena, Visakhapatnam - the National Integration Cultural Program marking Kargil Vijay Diwas.
